text: A formation of these armour-clad pikemen is a deadly hedgehog pointed at the enemy.
Greatswords are uncommon in the south, and the accomplished duellists who wield them can be found challenging entire regiments on bridges for sport.
Generals - and treasurers - need the best protection possible.
Smaller, mobile cannons can be instrumental in advanced tactics.
Protected by huge wooden shields, these crossbowmen can return fire with relative impunity.
Why is the rum always gone?
Tilean knights would often fight in 'broken' or unaffiliated groups and assemble for daring charges.
The Condottieri's own relatives, heirs to the Tilean Knights who bested the Bretonnians at Ravola.
Ostentatious and lethal with their red enamelled armour and peculiar dual-wielding techniques, the Knights Encarmine are a spoiled fury on the battlefield.
Experienced and well-protected, the Carabiniers have their muskets always pointed in the most dangerous blindside of the enemy.
A reliable force of veterans in heavy armour and the best handguns.
The fellow human is hardly worrisome when one has faced murderous lizardmen in Lustria.
These hardy mercenaries have learned how to best deal harm unpunished.
Good horses and fine steel moving fast on the battlefield.
The Order of the Eagle is the armed protector of Myrmidia on the battlefield.
Dwarf-crafted gear and proud hearts bring forth the legacy of Khypris.
In the lawless lands of the Borderlands, these men are the self-appointed judges, juries and executioners of those they consider villains.
Commoners armed with bows have many chances to help against incursions from the Badlands.
Lance formations of Bretonnians who got mired in the Borderlands, mixed with distant heirs, squires and emulators. Fairly well-equipped and trained, but distinctly delusional.
A solid force trained after the template of Sven Carlsson's regiment, often even hand-picked by the mercenary prince himself.
Hardy riders accustomed to borderlands warfare might be able to run down the smaller incursions on their own.
To the sufficiently shrewd and tough, an Orc is just another prey.
Sitting in a shade of grey between Order of the Eagle and Estalian Inquisition, the Black Watch is made of the most fanatical and stubborn among knightly aristocracy.
There's a kind of mercenary and generic armed rascal for whom "fairplay" is just another one of those funny bretonnian cheeses.
Shouting words of encouragement and promises of higher salary, the Paymaster makes sure the hired fighters don't get too hesitant.
The contentious duellists of the south are famous for their skill and eccentricity. This is twice as true for those who eschew the protection of both armour and shield.
The Order of Fury embodies the most vengeful aspect of their goddess and the martial wrath of Myrmidia's first Sister. These shieldmaidens fight in a controlled whirlwind of righteous wrath.
A crossbow is an old friend to the Tileans and other southerners, useful in capable hands even on horseback.
The highlanders from the Irrana Mountains are tough yet unruly people, an odd sight in the mercenary hosts.
The diminutive name is less about the length of their polearms and more what better troops call these militias for their salary and worth.
Emergency levies and cheap mercenaries can be assembled to make up a shield wall.
With pike infantry being the queen of battle in the south, these halberdiers are less trained at counter-cavalry than they'd sometimes wish, but a long stick is a long stick.
Formed by centuries-old kislevite minorities, this Kossar guard is a mixture of Kislev and the south, a solid archer guard for wealthy princes.
We may not be the Empire... but everybody knows the best crossbowmen come from Tilea!
Southerners are more awkward around gunpowder than Imperials, but their handguns are acceptable and pack a punch.
Little more than flimsy falconets according to engineers from Nuln, but as maneuverable as pistols compared to bigger cannons.
These Chamon-touched apex predators ferociously watch over their coastal mountains and cliffs, but will approve of the right amount of greed and moral fiber in select humans.

The secrets of dealing with Golden Lions were for a short time a monopoly of the city of Miragliano: in the highly 'dynamic' Southern Realms, such knowledge and techniques spread fast.\\n\\nGolden Lions prefer to nest on cliffs and rocky grounds with a good view of their territories, especially by the coast. As predictable, they are highly territorial and protective of their pride of wingless lionesses and cubs, and they are ferociously hostile particularly towards any Manticore or Ratman who intends on infesting their domains.\\n\\nWhen it comes to humans, females do not trust them and male Golden Lions do not form lasting bonds, but they respect what they innately perceive as the right balance of greed, valour and justice. When approached by a human leader who might want to secure the services of such a beast, Golden Lions are quick judges and executioners of character: the aspirant is either torn to bloody ribbons, or manages to secure a temporary pact with the lion in exchange for precious metals for its hoard, and 'leading' the beast towards enterprises it approves of. Dominant lions will invariably remain with their pride, and instead let younger and secondary males go with the petitioner.\\n\\nOutside of emulating one of the few Condottieri who successfully befriended a Golden Lion, there is little one can foresee in advance of their own chances of success, for the lions' inclinations are known only as rough guidelines. \\nMany have tried and failed, such as Lupio Sunscryer of Magritta, who self-assuredly approached a lion's den and narrowly escaped with his life.
